Explanation of relationship of significant CapEx and OpEx required to implement actions taken or planned to key performance indicators required under Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2021/2178。行动支出与分类法绩效指标关联。每个行动单独关联资源、期间和减排量；已实现与预期减排不可混同，减排量不是绝对排放量。
